# Three.js runtime assets

EarthScene packages the following runtime files from the installed Three.js dependency so applications do not need to copy decoder assets into their public directory:

- Draco geometry decoder JavaScript, WebAssembly wrapper, and WebAssembly binary.
- Basis texture transcoder JavaScript and WebAssembly binary.
- Water normal textures from the Three.js r184 Water2 example.

The applicable Three.js MIT license is included in `water-three-MIT.txt`.
